entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: A reclusive astronomancer and archmage of Nephalia who is called to Lambholt to deal with a killer and works with the inquisitor Rem Karolus.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: A boastful cathar, the blade of the inquisitors, hired to slay werewolves in Lambholt.

entities.name: Hailin
entities.description: Vadrik's husband, born in Lambholt, who sings strange rhymes.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: Vadrik's old friend and fellow astronomancer, now gone.

entities.name: Malynn
entities.description: A stern, elderly crone of the Lambholt council who taught Hailin as a boy and insists that Old Stickfingers is the killer.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: A young woman, daughter of the missing farmer Arinos, who knows the words of the summoning and performs the binding ritual.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: A farmer who went missing; he summoned Old Stickfingers to guard his farm and was killed by it.

entities.name: Dein Salvasi
entities.description: The wealthiest man in Lambholt, who hired Rem and was found dead after arguing with Arinos.

entities.name: Lakil
entities.description: A shepherdess found dead in the pasture.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: An ancient guardian hearth spirit, tall and thin with antlers and too many green-glowing eyes, who is summoned by Arinos and kills those he thinks are intruders.

entities.name: Council of crones and mothers
entities.description: A council of ten women who lead the village of Lambholt and called for Vadrik.

entities.name: Inquisitors
entities.description: The order whose blade is the cathar Rem Karolus, regarded by Vadrik as all bravado and no brains.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: A small farming village in Kessig with a palisade, an inn and a stone town hall, the birthplace of Vadrik's husband.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region of Innistrad where Vadrik's lighthouse tower stands.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: The forest from which the farmlands of Lambholt were carved.

entities.name: Salvasi manor
entities.description: The home of the wealthy Salvasi family in Lambholt, found broken open and empty.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the village lies.

entities.name: Stickfingers' mobile
entities.description: A mobile of twigs and bark hung from Arinos's porch that binds Old Stickfingers as guardian of the house.

events.summary: Vadrik arrives at Lambholt at night, called for help, and is nearly shot by a nervous guard.
events.quote: a crossbow bolt flew past his head and sunk halfway to its fletching into a nearby alder

events.summary: Vadrik meets the council of crones and mothers and the inquisitor Rem Karolus, who was hired by Dein Salvasi, and they agree to work together.
events.quote: "Then I suppose we'll be working together."

events.summary: The council explains the disappearances of Arinos and travelers and the death of Lakil; Malynn says that Old Stickfingers has come out of rhyme and story.
events.quote: "It was Old Stickfingers, it was," Malynn said.

events.summary: A man bursts in to report another murder.
Vadrik examines three bodies in a pasture, one a werewolf reverted on death, all pierced as if by arrows.
events.quote: Well, two dead people and one dead werewolf

events.summary: Vadrik casts a tracking spell with star dust and, annoyed at Rem calling him a hound, makes Rem's mouth vanish briefly.
events.quote: His mouth, more importantly, was gone, disappeared by Vadrik's magic.

events.summary: The two follow the tracks to an aspen grove where Old Stickfingers appears behind Vadrik.
events.quote: Old Stickfingers lived up to his name.

events.summary: Rem stabs Stickfingers and Vadrik blasts him with ice; Rem drives his blade through the creature's face and it vanishes.
events.quote: Rem stood up and drove his blade through the beast's chin, up through his face.

events.summary: In the morning Vadrik meets Ariosa, Arinos's daughter, and sets out to investigate the Salvasi manor.
At the Salvasi manor Vadrik and Rem find a broken door, an empty house, signs of violence and a message in ash, and Vadrik finds black goat fur.
events.quote: Instead of a warm welcome and food, the pair found a door broken open, hanging from one hinge.

events.summary: At Arinos's farm Vadrik finds a twig mobile and deduces that Arinos summoned Stickfingers to get rid of Salvasi.
events.quote: "Arinos summoned Stickfingers to dispose of Salvasi and save his farm," Vadrik said.

events.summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
events.quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

events.summary: The village bell tolls: Stickfingers is inside the walls, and Ariosa says that Vadrik and Rem set him free.
events.quote: "Just came from home," she said to Malynn, then she looked daggers at the pair of men. "They set him free."

events.summary: Malynn explains that Stickfingers is a hearth spirit of this place and cannot be sent away; Vadrik realizes he was summoned to protect, not to kill.
events.quote: "So he was summoned, not to kill, but to protect?"

events.summary: Vadrik works out that Arinos did not finish the summoning, so Stickfingers killed intruders on the old estate's land; Rem holds the monster back and Vadrik heals him.
events.quote: Killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.

events.summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
events.quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.

events.summary: Vadrik declines Rem's offer to team up and rides home, but wonders why the second bed was made and why Ariosa survived unscathed.
events.quote: How odd it was that Ariosa had survived, unscathed.

relations.quote: Do a simple job, get home to his husband Hailin.

relations.note: They work together reluctantly to deal with Stickfingers.
He is the blade of the inquisitors.
relations.quote: I am cathar, the blade of the inquisitors.

relations.note: Malynn sits among the crones and mothers who called for Vadrik.
relations.quote: "We don't know that, Malynn," the eldest crone in black said

relations.note: Vadrik concludes that Arinos built the sigil and summoned Stickfingers with it.
relations.quote: Built the sigil and hung it from the farmhouse.

relations.note: Stickfingers killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.
relations.quote: Killed Arinos, Salvasi, and more besides.

relations.note: Neighbors who argued, Arinos threatened with losing his land.
relations.quote: He'd been arguing with his neighbor, Dein Salvasi, the wealthiest man in Lambholt.

relations.note: Lambholt lies in the farmlands carved from the Ulvenwald.
relations.quote: through the farmlands that brave souls had carved out from the Ulvenwald.
